TENTS

PVC fabric-based tents such as pagodas, pyramids, and marquees, use durable, weather-resistant PVC membranes stretched over metal frames. These tents offer versatile, lightweight, and aesthetically appealing solutions for events, exhibitions, and temporary shelters.

MS TENTS

Made up of powder coated MS frames, these tents are completely based on nut & bolt system. While a bit bulky, having multiple pieces and rope based fabric installation makes it easy for anyone to do the installation and uninstallation.

ALUMINIUM TENTS

Made up of Aluminum frame, these tents tend to last longer with minimal maintenance. Easier to install compared to MS tents being lighter in weight, these tents will blow your mind with the level of beautification they can add to the event!

CUSTOM DESIGNS

Custom made designs that suit your specific needs (be it constrictions as per site conditions, or satisfying your creative needs), these tents can be a landmark show piece of your events. Both permanent as well as temporary installations are possible.
